statement: Identity views and the developer-console pixel inspector retain deferred IDs, camera and draw metadata on explicit refresh. Armed viewport picking converts window/DPI coordinates once, labels render/output resolutions and ignores disarmed or out-of-image clicks. A fixed nearest-texel 9 by 9 deferred-albedo zoom shares the one-record 48-byte inspection readback. Freeze retains one frame of albedo, normal/material, depth, IDs, camera and draw table; output resize and render-scale changes invalidate pending selections and retained storage. Clipboard export copies the exact schema-1 probe; closed and idle inspectors do not read back. When producer coverage is incomplete, identity snapshots and the inspector retain supported identities, hatch unsupported records and pixels, and explicitly report incomplete identity. Aborts, attachment failures and registry refusals still reject display; bundle publication retains the strict identity completion check. Registered DiagnosticInspector, DiagnosticInspectorGl and DiagnosticViewportGl regressions cover conversion, refusal, consistency, resize, request counts, export and mixed coverage; native execution remains pending.
